weight_scope: Frozen Notebook 68 transfer weights, no new RL training. Physical/expanded counts are separately declared ordering features. Timing repetitions use one deterministic seed.
cost_ceiling_scope: Production complete-theory and 28+48 interface admission wall time only. Independent replay, recipient guard compilation, search and whole certification are additionally charged separately. Ceiling is checked before the next admission and may overshoot by one in-flight query. Incomplete promoted admission stops before any expanded search.
inventory_semantics: Level1 is the complete same 28 authored ground logical interfaces, not literal native-square placements. Promoted adds all 48 actual searched receptor specializations. This language change is separate from base/fixed/learned ordering within an exactly equal inventory.
pipeline_scope: Independent whole-native replay may overlap production on the same host. All elapsed times are hardware/workload observations, not statistical speed evidence. Every exact search tree is saved before whole certification. No host logical oracle enters search, no binding sample supplies graph counts, and all fallbacks/rollback remain unchanged.
compilation_gate: High-level point adaptation; an occupancy-preserving expansion to primitive Wang squares remains open. No universal-closure claim or explicit coordinate geometry.
